description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CVS Health is building a more connected, convenient, and compassionate health care experience. The Associate Software Development Engineer will develop automation solutions, integrations, workflows, scripts, tools, APIs, and operational dashboards to improve reliability, compliance, efficiency, and business value. The role partners with engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges and drive continuous improvement.
Software engineer building workflow automation, API integrations, scripts, and operational dashboards

Responsibilities:
• The new hire will develop and implement automation solutions that streamline operational processes, improve compliance, and reduce organizational costs
• Responsibilities include building integrations, automating workflows, developing scripts and tools, leveraging APIs, creating operational dashboards, and partnering with engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges
• The role will require strong analytical, problem-solving, and software engineering skills to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and deliver solutions that create measurable business value

Requirements:
• Work visa sponsorship **is not** available for this role. This includes participation in Curricular Practical Training (CPT), Optional Practical Training (OPT), and F-1 Visa programs
• Must have successfully completed corporate internship program
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field
